evidence_entries.statement: SharedManifest layout is 64 bytes with 64-byte alignment and documented field offsets; layout alone does not establish cache coherence, RFO traffic or performance

Seqlock SPMC protocol model (loom replica of shared_manifest_core.rs, wrapped by seqlock.rs; 1 writer x 1-2 readers) yields no torn read under bounded model checking (max 2 preemptions); production code is not itself model-checked

Epistemic halt sets the admission flag to POISONED (0xDEAD_6060) and records SignedDurable / UnsignedDurable / PersistenceFailed evidence on real temporary files; without an operational key it writes no signed file and never a synthetic signature

Halt receipts are COSE_Sign1 structures (coset) with protected alg = EdDSA (-8) and an attached CBOR halt payload; a same-process Ed25519 sign/verify roundtrip recovers epoch, timestamp and reason. Conformance with RFC 9942 (COSE Receipts) is NO_VERIFICADO and not implemented
The Apple Secure Enclave bridge verifies P-256 signatures; its automated cryptographic test uses software keys

Persistent SQLite ledger rows are hash-chained with the legacy SHA3-256 implementation; tests detect row tampering and truncation and assert PRAGMA synchronous=FULL. WAL mode and BEGIN IMMEDIATE are used by the code but not asserted by the selected tests
Merkle state roots are computed deterministically, with Python/Rust bisimulation of the BLAKE3 conformal tree; exposure of the root through MCP is not exercised by this evidence (NO_VERIFICADO)

For accepted abstract traces, BabylonTrace proves even declared read sequences (TraceReadsEven), and AX0 proves countDispatches <= 1 from Proposed; neither theorem models Rust payload loads or physical memory ordering
In-memory HashChainedLedger provides cryptographic tamper detection
Heterogeneous 2/3 verification quorum over 3 engines (Rust, Lean 4, Z3)
The local benchmark reports elapsed time, throughput and average latency for 1,000,000 sequential seqlock publish/read iterations; it does not measure RFO traffic, idle CPU or energy consumption
The MCP server does not list a sign-off tool, and calls to causal_register_sign_off fail closed with an AX-0 error, both in-process and over stdio, while the gate keeps refusing the task
A consumed authorization cannot be dispatched a second time by the executor, including after process death and reopening the file ledger
EDIN workers cannot execute protected effects directly without verified COSE authorization over the IPC Unix socket boundary
A dispatch without a durable result becomes UNKNOWN at restart and is never retried automatically

A resource whose precondition digest or inode identity changes between authorization and effect is rejected before mutation; for filesystem DELETE_FILE, the TOCTOU gap is closed via atomic quarantine isolation and post-rename verification
Signing or persistence failures produce explicit errors; no zeroed or synthetic signature is emitted

Under 1000 one-process-per-iteration runs covering 3 SIGKILL crash points and a no-crash control, no nonce produces more than one effect, no DISPATCHED survives restart, and every archived authorization replay is rejected
EffectTx guarantees SAFETY and NON-INTERFERENCE for DELETE_FILE: under 100 concurrent workers and swap race attacks, unauthorized destructions == 0 and unquarantined deletions == 0

The SHARUR-100 stress campaign runs 100 threads: 50 append concurrently to CortexPersistLedger with 0 errors and a verified hash chain. The 50 adversarial rejections are simulated by label checks inside the campaign script, not by the production AX-0 gate

KudurruBudgetGate and AtomicKudurruBudgetGate are 64 bytes with 64-byte alignment. They reject bids above a static max_bid_cents, above the daily ceiling (the atomic CAS never exceeds it in a 32-thread test) and with zero win-probability or odds. After 60 consecutive sub-minimum ROAS epochs they return ApoptosisHalt{0xDEAD_6060} to the caller. Bounded loom models (2 threads, max 2 preemptions) check that concurrent reservations never exceed the daily budget, that rolling back an unspent reservation alongside a concurrent reservation stays consistent, and that concurrent epoch telemetry keeps a consistent underperformance counter

AdmissionController checks the observed atomic depth against capacity and a service-time estimate multiplied by depth cast to u32 before reserving a slot; this heuristic does not guarantee actual waiting time or starvation freedom

ScopedHandle and McpCapabilityBroker enforce: Tool Available != Tool Authorized != Effect Authorized. Under 10,000 adversarial trials across 5 attack vectors, unauthorized_effects == 0, capability_escalations == 0, stale_token_acceptances == 0, tool_identity_confusions == 0, and configuration_drifts == 0

Confined AI agent processes cannot mutate or unlink protected OS resources or the SQLite ledger directly (macOS Seatbelt / EPERM); all reachability paths G=(V,A) from agent to protected resources are mediated by the BABYLON broker, and the 5-test Omega Campaign (BYPASS-001, AUTH-002, RACE-003, CRASH-004, REVOCATION-005) passes on real OS files

Under SIGKILL between physical syscall and receipt commit (FL014_RECEIPT_LOSS), blind automatic retries are rejected with AmbiguousOutcomeRequiresReconciliation and explicit inode reconciliation consolidates the receipt without duplicate effect; transitive dependency or skill/policy drift (FL015_TRANSITIVE_DRIFT / POLICY_ROLLBACK / RUNTIME_LOAD) invalidates deployment permits fail-closed

BabylonAcsGuard enforces OWASP ACS v0.1.0 over AF_UNIX peer-verified sockets, rejects Fail-Open (on_decision_failure='proceed') with 0xDEAD_6060, compresses human wait stalls by >514x (n=30 cohorts, CI95), reconciles VOP-1 UNKNOWN states against physical witness digests, and invalidates capabilities upon skill/tool/policy drift (BabylonDriftGuard)
P-256 verification binds the complete canonical CBOR dispatch intent and consumes its nonce in SQLite WAL/FULL before dispatch, rejecting replay across connections and after SIGKILL

The Ring-0 TPM 2.0 wire encoder builds a bit-exact 73-byte TPM2_Quote command matching TCG TPM 2.0 Part 3 section 16.4, and parse_quote_response parses TPMS_ATTEST with fail-closed bounds (extraData == causal digest, PCR match, ECDSA signature non-zero)

The Ring-0 NSM encoder produces the deterministic canonical CBOR Attestation request {Attestation: {user_data: bstr(32 causal digest), nonce: bstr(8 big-endian logical_tick)}} as 73 bytes with shortest-form heads (RFC 8949 section 4.2.1), matching a frozen golden vector
The macOS MCP backend checks the real stdio protocol and Seatbelt confinement before admitting a candidate, with bounded execution and fail-closed rejection

The Regulatory Evidence Graph evaluator (babylon.assurance.claim.v1) enforces AcceptEvidence(c,a) => Bound(c,a) & Applicable(c,a) & Verified(c) and TechnicalPASS != LegalConformity across 1,000 controlled mutations (8 families x 125) and 40 in-test boundary cases (4 modes x 10), with 0 false acceptances, 0 false rejections and selective preservation of orthogonal claims; the BABYLON Assurance Gateway wraps this evaluator and is not exercised by the mutation loop

CortexMCPServer exposes the read-only babylon_autoroute_evaluate tool (and cortex_autoroute_evaluate alias) evaluating task complexity, model/effort fitness, KV-cache prefix hysteresis, and S0_LOCAL_AIRGAP secret routing with average latency < 100 us in the local 500-iteration test
